queries.nl: For each current NBA team, what is the average number of NBA championships won by its listed players?
queries.reference_sql: SELECT p.team, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_championships FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name GROUP BY p.team
queries.quwarts_sql: SELECT p.team, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_championships FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name GROUP BY p.team

queries.quwarts_sql: SELECT college, MAX(mvp_awards) AS max_mvp_awards FROM player WHERE college != '' GROUP BY college HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
